name: Dorado (Puerto Rico, United States)
description: Three horizontal stripes of gold, brown and gold, with a brown triangle based on the hoist leading into the brown stripe, charged with five white fleurs-de-lis arranged in a T.
history: Dorado is a town and municipality on the northern coast of Puerto Rico. The gold stripes symbolise the town's name and the brown stripe its patron, Saint Anthony of Padua; the fleurs-de-lis are the roundels of the coat of arms, adopted on 27 March 1978.

features.role: five fleurs-de-lis arranged in a T, from the arms
